scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.forge:analytics:off: npx forge settings set usage-analytics false
scripts.tunnel: concurrently -n ui,forge -c cyan,yellow "npm run dev --workspace static/app -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3000" "npm run forge:analytics:off && npx forge tunnel"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx forge deploy
scripts.install:jira: npm run build && npx forge install
